items.q: A thick waxy cuticle and sunken stomata are adaptations to:
items.qAf: ’n Dik waskutikula en ingesonke huidmondjies is aanpassings vir:
items.explain: These features reduce water loss in xerophytes.
items.explainAf: Hierdie kenmerke verminder waterverlies in xerofiete.

items.q: Plants in very wet soil that have air spaces in their stems are adapted to:
items.qAf: Plante in baie nat grond wat lugruimtes in hul stingels het, is aangepas by:
items.explain: Aerenchyma lets oxygen reach submerged roots.
items.explainAf: Aerenchiem laat suurstof na ondergedompelde wortels toe.

items.q: Which adaptation helps a plant conserve water in a desert?
items.qAf: Watter aanpassing help ’n plant om water in ’n woestyn te bewaar?
options: Many open stomata during the day
optionsAf: Baie oop huidmondjies gedurende die dag
items.explain: CAM plants open their stomata at night, reducing water loss.
items.explainAf: CAM-plante maak hul huidmondjies snags oop, wat waterverlies verminder.

items.q: Mosses and ferns are non-flowering plants that reproduce using:
items.qAf: Mosse en varings is nie-blomplante wat voortplant deur:
items.explain: They reproduce by spores rather than seeds.
items.explainAf: Hulle plant voort deur spore eerder as sade.

items.q: Gymnosperms differ from angiosperms because gymnosperms:
items.qAf: Gimnosperme verskil van angiosperme omdat gimnosperme:
items.explain: Gymnosperm seeds are not enclosed in an ovary, so they are 'naked'.
items.explainAf: Gimnosperm-sade is nie in ’n vrugbeginsel toegesluit nie, dus is hulle 'naak'.

items.q: A plant has seeds enclosed in a fruit. It is most likely a:
items.qAf: ’n Plant het sade wat in ’n vrug toegesluit is. Dit is waarskynlik ’n:
items.explain: Fruit enclosing seeds is characteristic of flowering plants (angiosperms).
items.explainAf: Vrugte wat sade toesluit is kenmerkend van blomplante (angiosperme).

items.q: Plants with vascular tissue that reproduce by seeds in cones, such as pines.
items.qAf: Plante met vaatweefsel wat met sade in keëls voortplant, soos dennebome.

items.q: Flowering plants, which have seeds enclosed in a fruit.
items.qAf: Blomplante, wat sade in ’n vrug ingesluit het.

items.q: Simple plants with no vascular tissue, such as mosses.
items.qAf: Eenvoudige plante sonder vaatweefsel, soos mosse.

items.q: The structures on fern leaves that contain spores.
items.qAf: Die strukture op varingblare wat spore bevat.

items.text: Plants that are adapted to very dry conditions are called [[]]. Many store water in thick, fleshy leaves or stems and have a thick waxy [[]].
items.textAf: Plante wat by baie droë toestande aangepas is, word [[]] genoem. Baie berg water in dik, vlesige blare of stingels en het ’n dik wasagtige [[]].

items.explain: False. Ferns reproduce by spores; only gymnosperms and angiosperms have seeds.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Varings plant met spore voort; net gimnosperme en angiosperme het sade.

items.qAf: Mosse het water nodig vir bevrugting.
items.explain: True. Their sperm must swim through a film of water to reach the egg.
items.explainAf: Waar. Hul sperms moet deur ’n waterlagie swem om die eiersel te bereik.

items.q: Put the plant groups in the order in which they evolved, earliest first.
items.qAf: Rangskik die plantgroepe in die volgorde waarin hulle ontwikkel het, vroegste eerste.

items.q: Give TWO reasons why angiosperms are the most successful group of land plants.
items.qAf: Gee TWEE redes waarom angiosperme die suksesvolste groep landplante is.
points: Flowers attract animal pollinators, making pollination efficient.
Seeds are protected inside fruits, which help with dispersal / they have efficient vascular tissue (xylem vessels).
pointsAf: Blomme lok dierbestuiwers, wat bestuiwing doeltreffend maak.
Sade word binne vrugte beskerm, wat met verspreiding help / hulle het doeltreffende vaatweefsel (xileemvate).
